evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: ScZr3N4 is a published computational prediction in the 2023 primary screening study, with SG221 and separate hull/coupling model data. It is not first predicted here. The 2026-10-07 bounded exact-phase review found no experimental superconducting ScZr3N4 benchmark. Novelty is the matched Sc-for-Hf corner-site source construction in this reviewed catalogue.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Source Gamma optical compression and sampled path are stable at the stated scalar approximation. Fine pressure is -0.205 GPa despite zero symmetry-constrained forces. ScHf3N4 has larger lambda but lower separate Eli Tc, and already accepted YZr3N4 has substantially larger lambda; both controls are retained. Nitrogen vacancies, ordered-cation disorder, charge redistribution and alternate nitrides are appropriate falsifiers. No pure volume-only causal claim or inherited YZr3N4 qualification is used.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=-0.205 GPa, full max stress=0.205 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

counterevidence.scope: Coupling and separate source-model Tc move in opposite directions against this alternative; a monotonic coupling-to-Tc explanation is insufficient.
This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Sc replaces Hf on the single cation corner site while three Zr and all four N sites remain mapped. The volume contracts 0.5685%, Sc-N versus Hf-N falls 0.0043104 A and Zr-N also falls 0.0043104 A. All ten lambda values improve 6.741–28.257% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 14.993 to 16.568 K. This is a coupled cation/network intervention; the valence change is not converted to mobile n.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Cross the Sc/Hf unique-site substitution with a fixed-volume comparison and test the lowest N-vacancy/order competitor. A stable coupling gain at common source method supports screening; a missing metallic channel, unfavorable ordering basin or reversed paired response opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
